intended_object: A separator (generator) G in a category C: an object such that the hom functor C(G, -) is faithful, i.e. parallel morphisms f, g : X → Y with h ≫ f = h ≫ g for all h : G → X are equal. Inferred from the docstring and name.
explanation: IsSeparating P says: for all f g : X ⟶ Y, if h ≫ f = h ≫ g for every h : G' ⟶ X with P G', then f = g. With P the singleton property of G, this reduces to: if h ≫ f = h ≫ g for every h : G ⟶ X, then f = g. That is exactly the standard definition of a separator, and it is equivalent to C(G, -) being faithful. It is stated for an arbitrary category, which is the natural generality.
